findings.description: The match check changed from truthiness to 'is not None', so an empty match pattern is now compiled and accepted. The title only mentions accepting an empty message.
findings.rationale: Trigger: retry_if_exception_message(match="") with no message. Before this change, the falsy match raised the 'missing 1 required argument' TypeError. Now re.compile("") is stored, and _check calls self.match.match(...), which succeeds for every exception string, so every exception is retried. Impact: a caller who passes an empty pattern by mistake gets silent retries on all exceptions instead of an error. The title does not announce this change.
